verdict.rationale: Bruno ships built-in AI features, including an AI Chat Sidebar and BYOK/OpenAI-compatible model providers, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents adding or connecting MCP servers to Bruno. The Cursor, VS Code and Codex integrations run the other way (external agents working with Bruno collections), and custom providers are LLM endpoints, not MCP tool servers.
